div.head: VIIa Atr 3
div.ab: ⁊ gif hwa þis ne gelæste, ðonne gebete he þæt, swa swa hit gelagod is: bunda mid XXX p̃, þræl mid his hide, þegn mid XXX scill'.
⁊ gif hwa þis ne gelæste, ðonne gebete he þæt, swa swa hit gelagod is: bunda mid XXX p̃, þræl mid his hide, þegn mid XXX scill'.
And gif hwa þis ne gelæste, ðonne gebete he þæt, swa swa hit gelagod is: bunda mid XXX pænigum, þræl mid his hide, þegn mid XXX scillingum.
Und wenn einer dies nicht leistet, dann büsse er das, wie es gesetzlich bestimmt ist: der Bauer mit 30 Pfennig, der Sklav mit seiner Haut, der Thegn mit 30 Schill.
And if anyone does not do this, then let him make amends for it as is laid down by law: a peasant with 30 pence, a slave with his hide, a thegn with 30 shillings.
And if anyone does not render this, he shall make amends as has been established by law: a householder shall pay 30 pence, a slave shall undergo the lash, and a thegn shall pay 30 shillings.
And if anyone does not perform this, then he is to compensate for it as it is legally ordained: the freeman with 30 pence, the slave with a flogging, the thegn with 30 shillings.
And if anyone does not pay this, then he shall compensate for it in the manner that the law decrees: a householder with thirty pence, a slave with a beating, and a thane with thirty shillings.

note.label: revised penalty
note.quote: The penalty for a thegn's non-compliance with the fast was reduced from 120 shillings (VII 2:4) to 30 (VIIa 3)

div.note: thirty shillings: See the note to 7 Æthelred 2.4 above.

note.seg: Cf. VII, 2, 4, where similar penalties are inflicted for breach of the fast.

note.label: freeman
note.seg: bunda, a Scandinavian term for a peasant proprietor; the Latin has “free poorman”
